title: Marvelous, developer of the Story of Seasons series, opens up voluntary redundancy scheme as it seeks to reduce headcount by 65 employees
summary: Marvelous, the studio known for its work on the Story of Seasons series as well as the upcoming Eternal Anima, has announced the introduction of a voluntary redundancy scheme. Through this program, it's aiming to lower its headcount by 65 employees. Read more
